evidence.title: GitHub - twbs/icons: Official open source SVG icon library for Bootstrap. · GitHub

name: Bootstrap Icons
summary: Open source icon library with 2,078 SVG icons for use as SVG files, an SVG sprite or a web font.
description: Official open source icon library for Bootstrap: 2,078 icons across 24 categories such as arrows, brand, files & folders, devices and shapes. Icons ship as individual SVGs, an SVG sprite and a web font, with an npm package, CDN and a Figma library; usable with or without Bootstrap.
contains: 24 categories: alerts & status, apps, arrows, badges, brand, commerce, devices, files & folders, shapes …
SVG download, SVG sprite and web font
